description: We’re building Time Machine for Your Field, using NASA data and AI to help farmers test crop choices, understand risks, and plan smarter seasons. We welcome AI, GIS, data, software, and agriculture enthusiasts.
summary:
**Farm Time Machine – Understand Yesterday, Prepare for Tomorrow**

Farm Time Machine is an innovative agricultural intelligence platform designed to help farmers make smarter, data-driven farming decisions using Earth observation and climate data. The platform aims to integrate NASA datasets such as GPM IMERG for rainfall, SMAP for soil moisture, and MODIS/VIIRS for vegetation monitoring.

It allows users to explore historical weather patterns, analyze rainfall and temperature trends, monitor agricultural risks, and compare different crop choices through an interactive What-If Simulator. Farmers can also maintain field histories, replay previous farming decisions, and receive AI-powered agricultural guidance.

The platform provides role-based workspaces for farmers, agriculturists, and administrators, enabling expert consultation and reliable agricultural recommendations. With a mobile-friendly, bilingual interface, Farm Time Machine aims to make complex environmental data accessible and useful for farming communities.

Our mission is to transform NASA Earth observation data into practical agricultural insights, helping farmers build more informed, resilient, and climate-smart farming practices.
details: Farm Time Machine is an innovative agricultural intelligence platform designed to help farmers make smarter, data-driven farming decisions using NASA Earth observation data. The project aims to integrate NASA datasets such as GPM IMERG for rainfall, SMAP for soil moisture, and MODIS/VIIRS for vegetation monitoring. It allows users to explore 10 years of historical weather patterns, analyze rainfall and temperature trends, monitor agricultural risks, and compare crop choices through an interactive What-If Simulator. Farmers can also review previous farming decisions using the Decision Replay feature and receive AI-powered agricultural guidance. The platform provides dedicated workspaces for farmers, agriculturists, and administrators, supporting expert consultation and reliable recommendations. It offers a mobile-friendly, bilingual Bangla-English experience to make complex environmental data accessible to farming communities. We developed the web-based prototype using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with GitHub and GitHub Pages for source-code management and hosting. Our creative approach combines historical climate data, present agricultural insights, and future farming scenarios in one interactive platform. We considered data reliability, climate variability, farmer accessibility, mobile usability, local agricultural needs, privacy, and security. Our ultimate goal is to promote sustainable, climate-smart agriculture, improve farming resilience, and transform NASA satellite data into practical insights for a better agricultural future.
